stories.title: Dos militares españoles, ingresados en el Gómez Ulla tras ser agredidos por marroquíes en Ceuta

en.title: Two Spanish soldiers hospitalized at Gómez Ulla after being attacked by Moroccans in Ceuta
en.summary: Spain's Defense Ministry reported that soldiers were injured in two separate assaults by immigrants who recently entered Ceuta, with some hospitalized. Injuries included knee, leg, and shoulder wounds sustained while performing their duties.

stories.title: «Se le ha gestionado que pudiera aparcar en Ferraz»: la declaración sobre la autorización de acceso libre de Leire Díez

en.title: "Parking was arranged for her at Ferraz": statement regarding Leire Díez's free access authorization
en.summary: A Socialist Party worker testified that Leire Díez had access to the party headquarters' parking lot for meetings with Santos Cerdán. The testimony was given during a National Court investigation into alleged party misconduct.

stories.title: La venta del ático de Chamberí que compró la Comunidad de Madrid queda desierta tras no recibir ninguna oferta

en.title: Sale of Chamberí penthouse purchased by Madrid Regional Government remains vacant after receiving no offers
en.summary: The Madrid Regional Government received no bids for a penthouse listed at 6.7 million euros, resulting in the auction being declared void. The property will now be offered for sale indefinitely without a bidding deadline.

stories.title: Navantia entrega a Marruecos con discreción el primer buque militar que le vende en 40 años: "Cumplimos el contrato"

en.title: Navantia discreetly delivers to Morocco first military vessel sold in 40 years: "We are fulfilling the contract"
en.summary: Spanish state shipbuilder Navantia delivered a patrol boat to the Moroccan Navy without a public ceremony amid the Ceuta crisis. The companies agreed to avoid a formal public event for the handover.

stories.title: La subasta por el ático de Ayuso queda desierta por falta de ofertas

en.title: Auction for Ayuso's penthouse remains empty due to lack of offers
en.summary: A penthouse in Madrid's Chamberí neighbourhood with a starting price of 6.694.201 euros failed to attract any bidders at auction.

stories.title: Navantia entrega de tapadillo un barco de guerra a la Marina Real de Marruecos

en.title: Navantia discreetly delivers warship to Morocco's Royal Navy
en.summary: Spanish shipbuilder Navantia delivered a patrol vessel named Moulay Hassan I to Morocco's Royal Navy in a low-key administrative ceremony without public officials or guests.

stories.title: El voto por correo confirma la victoria del bloque de izquierdas en Suecia

en.title: Mail-in voting confirms left-wing bloc victory in Sweden
en.summary: Sweden's left-wing bloc secured 176 of 349 parliamentary seats with 49.5% of votes, enabling socialist Magdalena Andersson to form government, though coalition negotiations remain complex.

stories.title: El polémico ático se queda sin comprador y la Comunidad de Madrid muestra con documentos que no se adquirió para "residencia oficial" de Ayuso

en.title: Disputed penthouse remains unsold as Madrid Community documents it was not acquired as Ayuso's official residence
en.summary: Madrid's regional government released documents claiming the penthouse was intended as a workplace and occasional accommodation for visiting officials rather than as an official residence for the regional leader.

stories.title: Nadie compra el ático por el que el Gobierno de Ayuso pagó 6,3 millones de euros: la subasta queda desierta

en.title: No one buys the penthouse that Ayuso's Government paid 6.3 million euros for: the auction remains empty
en.summary: A penthouse purchased by Madrid's regional government for 6.3 million euros failed to attract buyers at auction. The property will be relisted for sale through an open adjudication process.

stories.title: El largo escrutinio en Suecia confirma la victoria del bloque de centroizquierda

en.title: The long count in Sweden confirms the victory of the center-left bloc
en.summary: Sweden's extended vote count confirms a center-left bloc victory. Former Prime Minister Magdalena Andersson must form a complex coalition with left-wing, centrist, and green parties to govern.

stories.title: Dos militares desplegados en Ceuta, ingresados en el Gómez Ulla de Madrid tras ser agredidos

en.title: Two military personnel deployed in Ceuta hospitalized at Gómez Ulla in Madrid after being attacked
en.summary: Two military members stationed in Ceuta were hospitalized in Madrid following an assault. The Defense Minister visited them and is monitoring their condition.

stories.title: Huesos rotos y operaciones: así están los militares evacuados de Ceuta al Hospital Gómez Ulla de Madrid tras agresiones de inmigrantes

en.title: Broken bones and operations: this is how the military evacuated from Ceuta to Gómez Ulla Hospital in Madrid are after attacks by immigrants
en.summary: Two military personnel evacuated from Ceuta to a Madrid hospital sustained injuries requiring surgery following attacks. One has already undergone surgery while the other awaits operation.

stories.title: Trump ve un "acto hostil" en la alianza UE-Canadá y amenaza con "severos aranceles" a Europa

en.title: Trump sees a "hostile act" in EU-Canada alliance and threatens "severe tariffs" on Europe
en.summary: The U.S. president has threatened to impose new tariffs and potentially sever commercial ties with the European Union if it grants Canada associate membership status.

stories.title: El fundador de TikTok se convierte en la mayor fortuna de Asia

en.title: TikTok founder becomes Asia's richest person
en.summary: Zhang Yiming, founder of Chinese technology company ByteDance and owner of TikTok, has surpassed Indian magnate Gautam Adani to become Asia's wealthiest individual according to Bloomberg's billionaire rankings.

stories.title: El Ibex supera los 19.800 puntos aupado por Wall Street y la caída del petróleo

en.title: Ibex surpasses 19,800 points boosted by Wall Street and falling oil
en.summary: The Spanish stock index rose above 19,800 points as Wall Street rebounded and crude oil prices declined, offsetting concerns about recent interest rate increases by the Federal Reserve.

stories.title: La subasta del ático de Ayuso en Chamberí queda desierta

en.title: Auction of Ayuso's penthouse in Chamberí receives no bids
en.summary: A Madrid property auction for a penthouse with a starting price of 6,694,201 euros failed to attract any offers.

stories.title: Por qué el romance de Mark Carney con Europa tiene sus límites

en.title: Why Mark Carney's romance with Europe has its limits
en.summary: Berlin opposes a fast-track process to grant Canada associated member status in the EU, with officials warning that Ottawa risks angering other EU partners.
